text:
```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  create-issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      issue_number: ${{ steps.create-issue.outputs.issue_number }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy
      
      - name: Create Issue
        id: create-issue
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/create-issue/main.go --title "New Issue" --body "This is a new issue"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  link-sub-issue:
    needs: create-issue
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy
      
      - name: Link Sub Issue
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/link-sub-issue/main.go --parent-issue-id ${{ needs.create-issue.outputs.issue_number }} --sub-issue-id "12345"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
